title: Recording
description: The contract between the Chrome extension and the pipeline (SS5). Everything here has already passed through in-browser redaction (SS7) -- no raw secret ever reaches this document.

id.description: e.g. rec_01J8X2. Stable; referenced by every run artifact.

objective.description: SS6.6 -- the tester's stated objective, verbatim. The one input the tool can never observe, and the primary source for the test case title. Optional; the tool must be fully usable without it.

narration.description: SS6.6 -- transcribed locally, timestamps anchored to the recorder clock.

annotations.description: Session-level annotations. Annotations bound to a specific action also appear on that event.

parameters.description: SS7.2 -- placeholders that were substituted, by name only. The raw values they replaced are never persisted anywhere.

FramePathSegment.title: FramePathSegment
FramePathSegment.description: One hop in the path from the top document to the element's document. SS6.2.

host.description: Tag name or selector of the shadow host element.

FramePath.title: FramePath
FramePath.description: Path from the top document down to the element's document. Empty means the top-level document.

origins.description: Every distinct origin touched during the recording. Load-bearing: the pipeline's pre-send gate checks these against the allowlist before sending anything to a training-eligible endpoint (SS9.12).

fidelitySummary.description: Count of each fidelity flag across all events. Lets the review UI warn before the tester opens a single step.

CapturedEvent.title: CapturedEvent
CapturedEvent.description:
SS6.2 -- a bundle per user action, not a continuous stream. Scroll, hover and mousemove are context, never steps, and do not appear here.

On the three snapshots: `before` is taken at the moment of the action; `after` is taken once the page settles (SS6.5), NOT on the next tick, because snapshotting immediately captures the state before the application has responded and loses the very evidence the assertion needs. `transient` is captured the instant a live region appears, ahead of settle, and is present only when something showed up that might vanish -- a toast that disappears within three seconds is otherwise ungroundable.

id.description: e.g. evt_027. Referenced by every downstream stage.

url.description: Document URL at the moment of the action.

network.description: Requests in this action's time window.

screenshot.description: Path to a PNG on disk. Never sent to a model (SS7.4).

keys.description: For keypress events: the key or chord, e.g. 'Enter' or 'Control+S'.

files.description: For file_select. Bytes are deliberately not captured (SS4 deferred list).

role.description: Computed accessible role, not the tag name. Resolved from an explicit role attribute or the implicit-role mapping.

name.description: Computed accessible name (dom-accessibility-api) -- the human label. Empty string when the element has none, which also raises no_accessible_name.

value.description: Post-redaction. A password field's value is '<<password>>' here and nowhere is it anything else.

boundingBox.title: BoundingBox
boundingBox.description: Viewport coordinates. Mainly for canvas interactions, where it is all we have.

coordinates.title: Coordinates
coordinates.description: Click point relative to the target. Only meaningful for canvas_interaction.

SemanticNode.title: SemanticNode
SemanticNode.description: SS6.3 -- role, accessible name, state. Never raw DOM HTML: 2-6 KB vs 50-200 KB, and the raw form overflows the context window and produces incoherent output on any model.

ref.description: Structural path within this snapshot, e.g. '0.2.1'. Stable for the snapshot; how query_element and the element_exists validator resolve a node.

state.description: disabled, checked, expanded, invalid, selected, required, readonly, busy, ...

landmark.description: nav, main, dialog, ... -- for locating the node.

scope.title: SnapshotScope
scope.description: SS6.3 -- scoped by default (nearest landmark/dialog ancestor). 'full' only when get_full_snapshot asked for it, which is itself an agentic decision: cheap view by default, expensive one on demand.

scopeRoot.title: ScopeRoot
scopeRoot.description: What the scope was anchored to. Absent when scope is 'full'.

liveRegions.description: SS6.3 -- every alert/status/log/alertdialog node anywhere in the document, regardless of scope. Outcomes appear far from the click, and this is where most expected results actually live.

truncated.description: Node budget was hit and the tree was cut. Surfaces rather than silently shortening.

DiffNode.title: DiffNode
DiffNode.description: A node in a diff, flattened -- no children, to keep diffs small enough to hand to a model whole.

SnapshotDiff.title: SnapshotDiff
SnapshotDiff.description: Computed at capture time (SS6.2), so the pipeline never has to re-derive it.

SettleInfo.title: SettleInfo
SettleInfo.description: SS6.5 -- why the recorder decided the application had finished responding. Diagnostic, and the reason a settle_timeout can be explained rather than merely flagged.

NetworkCall.title: NetworkCall
NetworkCall.description: SS6.4 -- captured by a fetch/XHR patch in MAIN world. Bodies are redacted in page context before they leave it.

requestBody.description: Redacted. Truncated past a size budget.

responseBody.description: Redacted. Truncated past a size budget.

requestHeaders.description: Allowlisted only. Authorization and Cookie are never recorded (SS6.4).

uncaught.description: An uncaught exception rather than a console.error call. Strong bug signal (SS14.1).

TesterAnnotation.title: TesterAnnotation
TesterAnnotation.description: SS6.7. The tool must be fully usable with zero annotations -- they raise quality, they are never required.

text.description: For intent_note this becomes the step name VERBATIM -- the model does not rewrite it.

target.title: AnnotationTarget
target.description: For assertion annotations: the element the tester pointed at.

NarrationSegment.title: NarrationSegment
NarrationSegment.description: SS6.6 -- a direct read on the test oracle. Retrieved via get_narration rather than pre-loaded, so an unambiguous step pays nothing for it.

SelectedFile.title: SelectedFile
SelectedFile.description: Name/size/MIME only -- bytes are deliberately not captured (SS4). Rendered as <<fixture: name.csv>>.

RedactionParameter.title: RedactionParameter
RedactionParameter.description: SS7.2 -- placeholders carry forward into the generated test as parameters, which makes Scenario Outline a natural extension rather than a separate feature.
